awaken.ladder.haymaker.2.name: Knuckle Shards
awaken.ladder.haymaker.2.look: Shards of amber light orbit the charging fist and close in as the charge fills.
awaken.ladder.haymaker.3.name: Shockfist
awaken.ladder.haymaker.3.look: A cone of force bursts out of the far side of the target along the punch.
awaken.ladder.haymaker.3.does: Foes behind the target take half damage and are pushed back.
awaken.ladder.haymaker.4.name: Cannonball
awaken.ladder.haymaker.4.look: A launched target trails dust and a ring of force where it lands.
awaken.ladder.haymaker.4.does: A fully charged target flies as a projectile and hits whatever it crashes into.
awaken.ladder.haymaker.5.name: Meteor Fist
awaken.ladder.haymaker.5.look: Your forearm is wrapped in a spiral of embers while you charge. The punch tunnels the air with rings, and a ghost fist lands again a third of a second later.
awaken.ladder.haymaker.5.does: A second impact for 40% of the first.
awaken.ladder.haymaker.5.body: A stepping lunge punch with the off arm thrown back.
awaken.ladder.shockwave.2.name: Stone Crest
awaken.ladder.shockwave.2.look: The wave carries a curling crest of dust and stone along its front.
awaken.ladder.shockwave.3.name: Spine
awaken.ladder.shockwave.3.look: The wave leaves a crack along its path that erupts half a second later into a row of stone spikes.
awaken.ladder.shockwave.3.does: The spikes hit anything still in the line.
awaken.ladder.shockwave.4.name: Rolling Thunder
awaken.ladder.shockwave.4.look: The wave widens as it travels and kicks up the ground's own blocks.
awaken.ladder.shockwave.4.does: Foes are thrown higher and stay down for half a second.
awaken.ladder.shockwave.5.name: Landbreaker
awaken.ladder.shockwave.5.look: The stamp splits the earth: a rolling wall of upturned slabs rides the crest and a glowing fissure runs behind it, cooling from gold to red.
awaken.ladder.shockwave.5.does: Foes hit are stunned for half a second and the fissure burns for 2 s.
awaken.ladder.shockwave.5.body: The knee comes higher with a hang at the top; both fists drop as the foot plants.
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.2.name: Fault Lines
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.2.look: Glowing amber cracks run out from the impact and cool from gold to red over 2 s.
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.2.does: Foes standing on the cracks are slowed for a second.
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.3.name: Aftershock
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.3.look: A second, lower ring rolls out half a second later with its own thump.
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.3.does: The aftershock hits again for half damage.
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.4.name: Upheaval
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.4.look: Slabs of the real ground jut up round the impact and drop back.
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.4.does: Foes in the inner half are popped into the air.
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.5.name: Worldbreaker
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.5.look: You hang a beat in the air with light wound round both fists, then a dome of force flattens the dust, the crater rim glows and slabs rise in a ring.
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.5.does: The slam pulls foes inward first, then the aftershock throws them out.
awaken.ladder.ground_slam.5.body: Both fists raised overhead, a hang, a two-fisted drive into the ground.
awaken.ladder.leap.2.name: Comet Arc
awaken.ladder.leap.2.look: An amber ribbon traces your arc from the feet; a burst of dust at take-off.
awaken.ladder.leap.3.name: Hard Landing
awaken.ladder.leap.3.look: Your landing cracks Fault Lines into the ground.
awaken.ladder.leap.3.does: The landing hits harder and slows foes for a second.
awaken.ladder.leap.4.name: Rebound
awaken.ladder.leap.4.look: A ring of force snaps up off the landing.
awaken.ladder.leap.4.does: Foes are thrown up, and you can't be knocked back for a second after.
awaken.ladder.leap.5.name: Titanfall
awaken.ladder.leap.5.look: At the top of the arc, press again to drive straight down: a three-point landing, a glowing crater and a ring of rising slabs.
awaken.ladder.leap.5.does: The plunge hits like a Ground Slam from that height.
awaken.ladder.leap.5.body: Knee and fist hit the ground together; the head comes up last.
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.2.name: Molten Seams
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.2.look: The ripped chunk glows along its cracks and trails dust as it flies.
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.3.name: Shrapnel
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.3.look: The chunk bursts on impact into three tumbling rocks.
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.3.does: Each rock hits a different foe nearby.
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.4.name: Twin Rip
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.4.look: Your off hand tears out a second chunk a beat after the first.
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.4.does: A second throw at the next closest foe.
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.5.name: Mountain Hurl
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.5.look: You heave a three-block slab overhead with both hands; it tumbles end over end and lands as a rolling line of shock.
awaken.ladder.terrain_rip.5.does: The landing becomes a Shockwave along the line of the throw.
awaken.ladder.brace.2.name: Bronze Skin
awaken.ladder.brace.2.look: A bronze sheen flows over you and your feet crack the ground.
awaken.ladder.brace.3.name: Counter Shove
awaken.ladder.brace.3.look: When it ends, a ring of force shoves out from your feet.
awaken.ladder.brace.3.does: The shove hits for part of what you absorbed.
awaken.ladder.brace.4.name: Unmoved
awaken.ladder.brace.4.look: Arrows spark off the sheen and drop.
awaken.ladder.brace.4.does: Projectiles do half damage while you're braced.
awaken.ladder.brace.5.name: Mountain Stance
awaken.ladder.brace.5.look: Stone plates rise and circle you, catching what's thrown at you; when it ends they burst outward.
awaken.ladder.brace.5.does: The plates block three hits and cut the foes near you as they fly.
awaken.ladder.brace.5.body: Fists crossed at the chest, then slammed apart.
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.2.name: Static Hands
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.2.look: Arcs dance between your hands during the wind-up.
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.3.name: Forking
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.3.look: Each bolt forks to one more foe.
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.4.name: Thunderhead
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.4.look: A storm knot hangs over you for 3 s after the clap.
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.4.does: It drops one bolt a second on a foe near you.
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.5.name: Heaven's Clap
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.5.look: Hands raised overhead, the clap throws a flat disc of lightning and a pillar strikes you.
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.5.does: For 3 s your blows chain lightning to a second foe.
awaken.ladder.thunderclap.5.body: An overhead clap, the body rising onto the toes.
awaken.ladder.dash.2.name: Sonic Ring
awaken.ladder.dash.2.look: A crisp sonic ring and a pressure cone at the start; the red ribbons double.
awaken.ladder.dash.2.does: Foes you pass through are shoved aside.
awaken.ladder.dash.3.name: Momentum
awaken.ladder.dash.3.look: Your leading fist glows red for a second after a dash.
awaken.ladder.dash.3.does: Your next blow within a second hits 25% harder.
awaken.ladder.dash.4.name: Chain Charge
awaken.ladder.dash.4.look: Each chained air dash adds a red ring that stacks round you.
awaken.ladder.dash.4.does: From the third dash in a chain, half the energy comes back.
awaken.ladder.dash.5.name: Redline
awaken.ladder.dash.5.look: Your path stays drawn in the air as a red line of light that snaps a beat later.
awaken.ladder.dash.5.does: The snap cuts foes along the path for 60%.
awaken.ladder.dash.5.body: A lower, longer lean with one arm trailing.
awaken.ladder.flow.2.name: Ripple
awaken.ladder.flow.2.look: The slowdown arrives as a shell sweeping out from you; colour drains outside it.
awaken.ladder.flow.3.name: Afterimages
awaken.ladder.flow.3.look: You leave red afterimages as you move.
awaken.ladder.flow.3.does: Each kill during Flow adds half a second (2 s at most).
awaken.ladder.flow.4.name: Tempo
awaken.ladder.flow.4.look: Flow ends with a red snap round you.
awaken.ladder.flow.4.does: 20% faster movement and attacks for 3 s after.
awaken.ladder.flow.5.name: Red Hour
awaken.ladder.flow.5.look: Every foe you hit gets a hanging red slash mark; when Flow ends every mark snaps at once.
awaken.ladder.flow.5.does: The marks deal 30% of the damage you did during Flow.
awaken.ladder.flow.5.body: A breath in with the eyes closed, then a sharp open.
awaken.ladder.afterimage.2.name: Vivid
awaken.ladder.afterimage.2.look: The copy holds your pose sharply inside a glowing red outline.
awaken.ladder.afterimage.3.name: Mimic
awaken.ladder.afterimage.3.look: The copy swings once at the nearest foe.
awaken.ladder.afterimage.3.does: Its blow hits for half of yours.
awaken.ladder.afterimage.4.name: Snare
awaken.ladder.afterimage.4.look: Red threads hang off the copy.
awaken.ladder.afterimage.4.does: Foes that strike it are slowed.
awaken.ladder.afterimage.5.name: Phantom Rush
awaken.ladder.afterimage.5.look: The copy bursts into a ring of red crescents.
awaken.ladder.afterimage.5.does: Press again within 2 s to swap places with it.
awaken.ladder.afterimage.5.body: A hard sideways step out of your own body.
awaken.ladder.wall_run.2.name: Spark Steps
awaken.ladder.wall_run.2.look: Red sparks kick off each step on the wall.
awaken.ladder.wall_run.2.does: Half a second longer on the wall.
awaken.ladder.wall_run.3.name: Kick-off
awaken.ladder.wall_run.3.look: Leaving the wall leaves a red ring behind you.
awaken.ladder.wall_run.3.does: A burst of speed as you leave.
awaken.ladder.wall_run.4.name: Steady
awaken.ladder.wall_run.4.look: A thin red line marks your path along the wall.
awaken.ladder.wall_run.5.name: Street Runner
awaken.ladder.wall_run.5.look: A red speed ribbon trails you along the wall and you flip off the end.
awaken.ladder.wall_run.5.does: Each new wall within a second of the last adds a second to the run.
awaken.ladder.wall_run.5.body: The flip off the wall's end.
awaken.ladder.water_run.2.name: Wake
awaken.ladder.water_run.2.look: The water parts in a V-shaped wake with spray.
awaken.ladder.water_run.2.does: No slowdown as you step onto water.
awaken.ladder.water_run.3.name: Skip
awaken.ladder.water_run.3.look: Each stride leaves a ring of light on the surface.
awaken.ladder.water_run.3.does: A leap off water keeps your speed.
awaken.ladder.water_run.4.name: Still Water
awaken.ladder.water_run.4.look: The water stills in a circle under you.
awaken.ladder.water_run.4.does: You can stand on water for 2 s.
awaken.ladder.water_run.5.name: Tidewalker
awaken.ladder.water_run.5.look: Every step leaves a glowing ring; at full sprint you throw a bow wave.
awaken.ladder.water_run.5.does: The wave pushes foes in the water away.
awaken.ladder.water_run.5.body: Sprint posture leaning into the wave.
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.2.name: Bright Path
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.2.look: The path stays lit for a second.
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.3.name: Static Field
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.3.look: Where you land, crackle spreads over the ground.
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.3.does: Foes in it are slowed for 2 s.
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.4.name: Double Flash
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.4.look: A spare charge sparks at your heels.
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.4.does: A second flash within a second costs nothing.
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.5.name: Thunder Step
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.5.look: A bolt strikes from the sky at both ends of your path.
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.5.does: Everything on the path is stunned for half a second.
awaken.ladder.lightning_step.5.body: A snap of two fingers, then you are gone.
awaken.ladder.hover.2.name: Wind Rings
awaken.ladder.hover.2.look: Rings of wind turn under your feet.
awaken.ladder.hover.3.name: Updraft
awaken.ladder.hover.4.name: Calm Air
awaken.ladder.hover.4.look: Arrows bend away as they reach the wind round you.
awaken.ladder.hover.4.does: Arrows that reach you do half damage.
awaken.ladder.hover.5.name: Skyhold
awaken.ladder.hover.5.look: A disc of pale light forms under your feet.
awaken.ladder.hover.5.does: Allies can stand on it while you hover.
awaken.ladder.flight.2.name: Contrails
awaken.ladder.flight.2.look: White ribbons stream from hands and feet.
awaken.ladder.flight.3.name: Sonic Wake
awaken.ladder.flight.3.look: At top speed a vapour cone forms round you and booms.
awaken.ladder.flight.4.name: Long Haul
awaken.ladder.flight.4.look: The contrails stretch and hold longer.
awaken.ladder.flight.5.name: Jetstream
awaken.ladder.flight.5.look: A burst with a boom ring and a long contrail.
awaken.ladder.flight.5.does: Double-tap forward for a 2 s burst of speed.
awaken.ladder.flight.5.body: A tuck into a dive line.
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.2.name: Lens
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.2.look: A dark core with a bright violet rim; dust spirals inward.
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.3.name: Debris Ring
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.3.look: Chunks of the ground orbit the core.
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.3.does: The chunks hit foes they pass.
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.4.name: Crush
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.4.look: The knot visibly tightens as it runs.
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.4.does: Its damage climbs over its length.
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.5.name: Black Star
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.5.look: A tilted disc of violet light spins round the core; at the end it collapses and bursts.
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.5.does: The burst hits for 30% of what the well dealt.
awaken.ladder.gravity_well.5.body: Both hands press down and twist.
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.2.name: Grip
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.2.look: A ring of violet runes clamps the lifted mob.
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.3.name: Pair
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.3.look: A second ring takes the mob next to it.
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.3.does: Lifts a second foe near the first.
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.4.name: Tumble
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.4.look: Lifted mobs tumble slowly in the air.
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.5.name: Orbit Throw
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.5.look: What you lift orbits round you; the throw curves to your aim with a violet trail.
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.5.does: Throws everything you hold at once, each at its own target.
awaken.ladder.telekinesis.5.body: A two-handed gather, then a swing out like a sling.
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.2.name: Burning Entry
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.2.look: A comet trail and a shock cone as you dive.
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.3.name: Crater Rim
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.3.look: A ring of molten rock where you land.
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.4.name: Rebound
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.4.look: You bounce once into a second, smaller impact.
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.5.name: Starfall
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.5.look: Three smaller meteors fall round the impact a beat after you.
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.5.does: Each meteor hits the nearest foe.
awaken.ladder.meteor_dive.5.body: A rising spin before the drop.
awaken.ladder.gravity_flip.2.name: Upside Dust
awaken.ladder.gravity_flip.2.look: Dust and pebbles fall upward with the foes.
awaken.ladder.gravity_flip.2.does: Foes hang half a second longer.
awaken.ladder.gravity_flip.3.name: Collision
awaken.ladder.gravity_flip.3.look: Foes in the air drift together.
awaken.ladder.gravity_flip.4.name: Weightless
awaken.ladder.gravity_flip.4.look: A pale shimmer stays on you.
awaken.ladder.gravity_flip.5.name: Inverted Sky
awaken.ladder.gravity_flip.5.look: The sky flips twice: up, down, up, then the crash.
awaken.ladder.beam.2.name: Helix
awaken.ladder.beam.2.look: A bright ribbon of light spirals round the beam and spins; embers peel off along it.
awaken.ladder.beam.2.does: Held on one target, the beam builds up to 20% more damage over 1.5 s, and the spiral tightens as it builds.
awaken.ladder.beam.3.name: Lance
awaken.ladder.beam.3.look: A second ribbon turns the other way (a double helix) and a flare bursts at every body it passes through.
awaken.ladder.beam.3.does: Pierces the first foe and carries on to a second at 60%.
awaken.ladder.beam.4.name: Corona
awaken.ladder.beam.4.look: Where the beam lands, a molten pool spreads and a ring of light turns round the end.
awaken.ladder.beam.4.does: The pool burns foes standing in it for 2 s.
awaken.ladder.beam.5.name: Sunspear
awaken.ladder.beam.5.look: The beam is born from a ring of runes at your palm. Three ribbons, a white-gold core, and on letting go a last pulse runs down the beam and bursts at the end.
awaken.ladder.beam.5.does: The last pulse deals 20% of what the beam dealt.
awaken.ladder.beam.5.body: A wide braced stance, the off hand flat on the forearm; on letting go, the palm closes.
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.2.name: Coil
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.2.look: A spinning coil of lightning wraps the charge orb.
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.3.name: Arc
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.3.look: On a hit the bolt jumps to a second foe.
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.4.name: Overcharge
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.4.look: Hold past full and the orb turns white and spits sparks.
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.5.name: Thunder Lance
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.5.look: A full charge fires a lance that leaves a crackling line for 2 s, and a bolt from the sky strikes the target.
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.5.does: The line shocks foes that cross it.
awaken.ladder.charged_shot.5.body: The bolt hand pulled back to the ear, then thrown like a spear.
awaken.ladder.nova.2.name: Orbits
awaken.ladder.nova.2.look: Two rings of light orbit the shell as it grows.
awaken.ladder.nova.3.name: Searing Shell
awaken.ladder.nova.3.look: The shell holds a second longer.
awaken.ladder.nova.4.name: Flare Arcs
awaken.ladder.nova.4.look: Plasma arcs leap from the shell to foes past its edge.
awaken.ladder.nova.4.does: Up to three of them, at half damage.
awaken.ladder.nova.5.name: Daystar
awaken.ladder.nova.5.look: You rise a little as a white-gold sun forms at your chest; the release is a shell, a ring on the ground and a pillar of light.
awaken.ladder.nova.5.does: Foes are blinded for a second and the afterglow burns.
awaken.ladder.barrier.2.name: Hex Shell
awaken.ladder.barrier.2.look: Hex cells light up where the shield is struck.
awaken.ladder.barrier.3.name: Stored Charge
awaken.ladder.barrier.3.look: The shield brightens as it takes damage.
awaken.ladder.barrier.3.does: The break shock grows with what it absorbed.
awaken.ladder.barrier.4.name: Second Skin
awaken.ladder.barrier.4.look: When it breaks, a thinner shell flickers back.
awaken.ladder.barrier.4.does: It re-forms once at a third strength for 3 s.
awaken.ladder.barrier.5.name: Halo Ward
awaken.ladder.barrier.5.look: Three shield plates orbit you and catch arrows; the break is a burst of light.
awaken.ladder.barrier.5.body: Palms pushed out, then drawn round in a circle.
awaken.ladder.overload.2.name: Gathering Arcs
awaken.ladder.overload.2.look: Arcs crawl over you while you gather.
awaken.ladder.overload.3.name: Fork
awaken.ladder.overload.3.look: The blast throws lightning to foes beyond it.
awaken.ladder.overload.4.name: Live Wire
awaken.ladder.overload.4.look: Your energy hits crackle during the afterglow.
awaken.ladder.overload.4.does: They jump to a second foe.
awaken.ladder.overload.5.name: Critical Mass
awaken.ladder.overload.5.look: You're lifted while you gather; the blast pulls in, then explodes, and leaves a ring of plasma.
awaken.ladder.overload.5.does: Pull then blast, and the ring burns for 3 s.
awaken.ladder.overload.5.body: Lifted, curled in, then thrown open.
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.2.name: Refraction
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.2.look: Each split throws a flare of split colour.
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.2.does: The split beams reach 4 blocks further.
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.3.name: Pierce
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.3.look: Split beams leave a flare at each body.
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.4.name: Bounce
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.5.name: Spectrum Crown
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.5.look: A crown of six prisms rises over your head and each fires its own beam.
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.5.does: Six beams find six different foes.
awaken.ladder.prism_lance.5.body: The chest opened, the head lifted to the crown.
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.2.name: Ink Wake
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.2.look: A trail of ink smoke with violet rims follows the step.
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.2.does: The backstab window is a second longer.
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.3.name: Blinding
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.3.look: A burst of ink at the back of the target's head.
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.3.does: The backstab blinds for a second.
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.4.name: Return
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.4.look: An ink pool stays where you left.
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.4.does: Press again within 2 s to step back to it.
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.5.name: Night Cut
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.5.look: You arrive in a low crouch and a crescent of shadow slashes through the target by itself; tendrils from the pool hold foes nearby.
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.5.does: The crescent lands the backstab for you, and tendrils hold foes near you for a second.
awaken.ladder.shadow_step.5.body: A low crouch arrival with a hand sweeping across.
awaken.ladder.cloak.2.name: Haze
awaken.ladder.cloak.2.look: A faint shimmer; allies see your outline.
awaken.ladder.cloak.3.name: Shade Step
awaken.ladder.cloak.3.look: Your hands trail ink while cloaked.
awaken.ladder.cloak.3.does: While cloaked, Shadow Step and Echo Swap cost nothing.
awaken.ladder.cloak.4.name: Ambush Mark
awaken.ladder.cloak.4.look: The first strike leaves a violet crescent on the foe.
awaken.ladder.cloak.5.name: Nightfall
awaken.ladder.cloak.5.look: A dome of dusk falls round you.
awaken.ladder.cloak.5.does: Foes inside lose track of your allies too.
awaken.ladder.cloak.5.body: Arms crossed, then drawn down like a hood.
awaken.ladder.echo_swap.2.name: Ink Line
awaken.ladder.echo_swap.2.look: An ink thread draws between the two places.
awaken.ladder.echo_swap.3.name: Hobble
awaken.ladder.echo_swap.3.look: Ink clings to the foes struck.
awaken.ladder.echo_swap.4.name: Double Swap
awaken.ladder.echo_swap.4.does: Swap back within 2 s for free.
awaken.ladder.echo_swap.5.name: Left Behind
awaken.ladder.echo_swap.5.look: A shadow copy stays where you were.
awaken.ladder.echo_swap.5.body: A clap that leaves your outline standing.
awaken.ladder.legion.2.name: Rim Light
awaken.ladder.legion.2.look: Soldiers rise from ink pools with violet eyes and lit edges.
awaken.ladder.legion.3.name: Charge
awaken.ladder.legion.4.name: Ink Death
awaken.ladder.legion.5.name: The Risen Guard
awaken.ladder.legion.5.look: A circle of runes spreads under you and the soldiers rise in a ring round a captain twice their size.
awaken.ladder.legion.5.does: The captain is a knight that lasts the whole time.
awaken.ladder.legion.5.body: One hand raised, palm up, then closed.
awaken.ladder.danger_sense.2.name: Edge Arc
awaken.ladder.danger_sense.2.look: A warning arc on the edge of your screen points to the threat.
awaken.ladder.danger_sense.2.does: You know where it's coming from.
awaken.ladder.danger_sense.3.name: Sooner
awaken.ladder.danger_sense.4.name: Read the Shot
awaken.ladder.danger_sense.4.look: Arrows aimed at you show as golden lines before they fly.

awaken.ladder.read_intent.5.name: Open Book

awaken.ladder.read_intent.5.body: Fingers to the temple, then a slow point.

awaken.ladder.decoy.4.name: Confusion

awaken.ladder.decoy.5.body: A flick of the hand three ways.

awaken.ladder.foresight.4.look: The blow that misses meets a gold flash.

awaken.ladder.cone.2.look: Drawn in blueprint lines, then filled.

awaken.ladder.cone.5.name: Pagoda

awaken.ladder.bulwark.4.name: Rest
